prior_importants.description: readPane captures the pane recorded for a merged session. That window was closed at merge but its pane id is kept, so after a tmux restart the view can show another window's text, including the operator's own, as this session's Window.

process_issues.description: Round 4 budget: spawned only correctness, security and guards. Skipped conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability under the round-4 rule. Also not spawned: review-spec (no closing keywords or linked issues) and review-workflow-safety (no .github/workflows change).
